title: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(7)
desc: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(7)

paragraphs.en: The high-speed rail from Beijing to Hefei cuts through the North China Plain, a vast stretch of flatland roughly the size of California.
paragraphs.zh: 北京开往合肥的高铁穿行于华北平原，这片广袤平原面积大致相当于美国加利福尼亚州。

paragraphs.en: Six days after my meeting with Galbot, I boarded the train around 6am, and found my seat through a scrum of groggy commuters.
paragraphs.zh: 拜访嘉博特六天后，我清晨六点左右登上列车，在睡意惺忪的通勤人群中挤到座位。

paragraphs.en: Outside, it was dark; nothing to see beyond my own reflection.
paragraphs.zh: 窗外天色漆黑，车窗上只能看见自己的倒影。

paragraphs.en: But as the train hurtled quietly southward, dawn began to break.
paragraphs.zh: 列车平稳向南疾驰，天边渐渐泛起曙光。

paragraphs.en: Tilled fields, apartment towers and electric pylons gradually came into view, flashing by the window.
paragraphs.zh: 耕地、居民楼与高压电塔依次映入眼帘，飞速从窗边掠过。

paragraphs.en: Toward the front of the cabin, a screen was playing a synchronised breakdancing routine performed by Unitree robots.
paragraphs.zh: 车厢前部的显示屏正在播放宇树机器人齐跳霹雳舞的视频。

paragraphs.en: Four hours later, the train pulled into Hefei.
paragraphs.zh: 四小时后，列车抵达合肥站。

paragraphs.en: I had come to see a newly built Huawei car factory where several of Chen Liang's robots, including the wheel-, window- and dashboard-installation machines, had been deployed.
paragraphs.zh: 我此行是参观一座新建华为汽车工厂，陈亮研发的多款自动化设备已在这里投入使用，包括车轮、车窗、仪表盘装配机器人。

paragraphs.en: Once a rural backwater, Hefei has transformed into an industrial centre that, together with its surrounding areas, produces more cars than Michigan.
paragraphs.zh: 合肥曾经只是偏僻小城，如今转型为工业重镇，连同周边区域的汽车总产量已超过美国密歇根州。

paragraphs.en: I took a cab to an enormous factory complex on the southern outskirts, where Huawei churns out its newest electric ultra-luxury sedan, the Maextro S800.
paragraphs.zh: 我打车前往城南一处大型产业园，华为在这里量产全新豪华纯电轿车迈界S800。

paragraphs.en: Chen greeted me in the factory cafeteria with his familiar grin.
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮在工厂食堂等候我，脸上依旧挂着熟悉的笑容。

paragraphs.en: Before we stepped on to the factory floor, his engineers helped me into some steel-toed shoes, while Chen fired off directions to his team.
paragraphs.zh: 进入生产车间前，工程师为我换上防砸安全鞋，陈亮同时快速向团队下达各项工作安排。

paragraphs.en: With his hard hat and green vest over his suit, Chen seemed a new man: more confident, the conductor of his own orchestra.
paragraphs.zh: 西装外搭配安全帽与绿色工装马甲的陈亮焕然一新，自信十足，如同统筹整场演出的指挥家。

paragraphs.en: Car factories are typically divided into four zones.
paragraphs.zh: 汽车工厂一般划分为四大生产区域。

paragraphs.en: The final assembly zone was quiet, clean and bright like a laboratory, its support beams and scaffoldings painted porcelain white.
paragraphs.zh: 整车总装车间安静整洁、光线明亮，如同实验室，厂房横梁与脚手架均粉刷成瓷白色。

paragraphs.en: As we walked through the storage region, unmanned carts – low, rectangular platforms – zipped by, ferrying car parts to work stations.
paragraphs.zh: 穿行仓储区域时，低矮的矩形无人转运车来回穿梭，将汽车零部件运送至各个工位。

paragraphs.en: Whenever we spotted a human worker, Chen described to me what they did and explained why robots still can't do it.
paragraphs.zh: 每当我们看到一线工人，陈亮都会向我介绍他们的工作内容，同时解释目前机器人尚且无法胜任该工序的原因。

paragraphs.en: We started at the flow racks, where workers pick up component parts – sensors, wires etc – and place them into bins.
paragraphs.zh: 我们先来到物料分拣货架区，工人在此取用传感器、电线等各类零部件，再放入收纳料箱。

paragraphs.en: These kinds of repetitive "pick and place" tasks are seen as particularly ripe for automation.
paragraphs.zh: 这类重复性拾取放置作业，普遍被认为最适合实现自动化改造。

paragraphs.en: (In October, Figure AI released a video of its humanoid robot doing a similar task at a BMW plant in South Carolina.)
paragraphs.zh: （去年十月，菲尔人工智能公司发布一段视频，展示其人形机器人在南卡罗来纳州宝马工厂完成了同类工序。）

paragraphs.en: Even here, Chen told me, humanoid robots do not yet match up to their human counterparts.
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮表示，即便是这类简单工序，人形机器人的作业水平依旧比不上人工。

paragraphs.en: "One worker has to manage so many different types of components, and each one needs to be grasped differently," he told me.
paragraphs.zh: “一名工人要处理数十种不同零部件，每种零件的抓取方式都不一样。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: The parts themselves were also changing.
paragraphs.zh: 零部件本身的形态也各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Just then, he pointed to a metal bracket still wrapped in foam packaging: "You have to strip that off too. It's a pretty complicated job."
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，他指向一件还裹着泡沫防护包装的金属支架：“还得把泡沫拆掉，整套工序十分复杂。”

paragraphs.en: As we walked deeper into the Huawei factory, we could see a queue of car bodies moving along an assembly line.
paragraphs.zh: 我们继续往华为工厂车间深处走，一长串车身沿着流水线缓缓移动。

paragraphs.en: Workers lined both sides, jumping in and out of the car shell with drills and other tools, tightening bolts and snapping connectors into place.
paragraphs.zh: 工人分列流水线两侧，手持电钻等工具钻进钻出车身，拧紧螺栓、插接各类线路接头。

paragraphs.en: Watching on, I got a sense of just how hard it would be to automate this.
paragraphs.zh: 亲眼看过之后，我才明白这套工序实现自动化的难度有多高。

paragraphs.en: The work looked far more chaotic and context-dependent than any pick-and-place task.
paragraphs.zh: 相比单纯的拾取放置工作，这里的作业流程杂乱得多，需要随时根据现场情况灵活调整。

paragraphs.en: When the Maextro sedan reached Chen's work station, the car was hoisted on to a raised platform, where three robotic arms sprung into action.
paragraphs.zh: 当迈界轿车车身运送到陈亮的设备工位时，车身被举升平台托起，三台机械臂立刻同步启动作业。

paragraphs.en: One arm locked a dashboard into place, the other two bolted them on to the car in seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一台机械臂固定仪表盘，另外两台在数秒内完成螺栓锁紧。

paragraphs.en: "This is our fully automated dashboard installation," Chen told me, marvelling at his own creation.
paragraphs.zh: “这是我们全套自动化仪表盘装配设备。”陈亮望着自己研发的设备，语气中满是赞叹。

paragraphs.en: The Guchi engineers stood behind a monitor. They were there mostly for troubleshooting.
paragraphs.zh: 固智的工程师们守在监控屏幕后方，主要负责设备故障排查。

paragraphs.en: "Before, workers had to guide robotic arms manually, and each car model needed different kinds of tooling because the models varied so widely," said Chen.
paragraphs.zh: “以前需要工人手动引导机械臂作业，而且不同车型配套工装差异巨大，得单独调试设备。”陈亮说。

paragraphs.en: No longer. "The progression is fascinating."
paragraphs.zh: 如今早已不用这么麻烦。“技术迭代的过程实在令人惊叹。”
